The proposer drafts the Curriculum Blueprint with learning outcomes and module structure. The draft is checked against Academic Policy and professional body requirements. An internal review by the curriculum panel evaluates coherence and resource feasibility against the Resource Capacity Statement. If the review identifies gaps, the blueprint is returned for revision and the process repeats. Once approved, the Curriculum Blueprint is issued as the basis for delivery. The design is registered with the awarding body if applicable.

### Produces
Curriculum Blueprint. Curriculum Approval. Module Specification for each module.

### Outcome
A new programme or module is fully specified and approved for offer.

### Fails when
The Market Demand Analysis shows insufficient demand and the proposal is withdrawn, leaving no approved curriculum.

Name: Curriculum Performance Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of monitoring module and programme performance against retention and attainment thresholds.

### Trigger
Completion of an academic term or year, signalled by the publication of Student Results Records.

### Consumes
Student Results Record supplies pass rates and marks. Module Evaluation Report supplies student feedback. Retention Data supplies withdrawal counts. Benchmark Data supplies comparison thresholds.

### Steps
The analyst aggregates results and retention data per module. The data is compared against threshold targets and Benchmark Data. Underperforming modules are flagged. A trend analysis is performed over previous years. A Curriculum Performance Report is produced with recommendations. The report is submitted to the curriculum committee. An Improvement Action Plan is created for flagged modules.

### Produces
Curriculum Performance Report. Module Improvement Recommendation. Improvement Action Plan.

### Outcome
Curriculum performance is measured and underperformance is identified for action.

### Fails when
Student Results Records are incomplete and the report cannot be produced, leaving performance unmonitored.

Name: Curriculum Retirement Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of phasing out a programme or module no longer offered.

### Trigger
A Retirement Proposal is submitted for a module or programme.

### Consumes
Retirement Proposal supplies the rationale and teach-out plan. Current Curriculum Blueprint supplies the structure. Student Enrolment data supplies current cohorts. Resource Reallocation Plan supplies the target for freed resources.

### Steps
The proposal is checked for impact on enrolled students. A teach-out schedule is defined. The retirement is approved by the faculty board. The Curriculum Blueprint is updated to mark the item as retiring. Affected students are notified. The final cohort is tracked through completion. Resources are reallocated according to the Resource Reallocation Plan. A Retirement Completion Record is created.

### Produces
Curriculum Retirement Decision. Teach-out Schedule. Student Notification. Retirement Completion Record.

### Outcome
Retired curricula are removed without harming enrolled students.

### Fails when
Current students cannot be accommodated by the teach-out schedule and the proposal is blocked.

Name: Digital Communication Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of digital communication channels, including email, collaboration platforms, and web content.

### Trigger
The arrival of a digital communication request or an issue with a communication channel.

### Consumes
Digital Communication Request supplies the content and target audience. Channel Configuration Record supplies the current settings for each platform. User Issue Report supplies the malfunction or access problem.

### Steps
The process validates the request against communication policy. It prepares the content for the selected channel. It schedules or sends the communication. It monitors delivery and engagement. It resolves user issues. It updates channel configuration. It reviews usage and cost. If a communication is incorrect, it issues a correction. It records all sends.

### Produces
Digital Communication Item states the sent content and channel. Channel Issue Resolution records the fix applied. Channel Performance Report records delivery and engagement metrics.

### Outcome
Digital communications are delivered effectively and the channels remain available.

### Fails when
A digital channel fails during a critical communication, causing message loss and user confusion.

Name: Disability Support Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of assessing and implementing disability support for students.

### Trigger
A student submits a Disability Support Request with evidence.

### Consumes
Disability Support Request supplies the student's needs. Medical Evidence supplies the diagnosis. Student Enrolment supplies the academic context. Reasonable Adjustment Policy supplies the adjustment options.

### Steps
The evidence is reviewed by a disability adviser. A support plan is drafted with reasonable adjustments. The plan is agreed with the student. Adjustments are communicated to relevant teaching and assessment areas. The plan is reviewed annually. The Student Record is updated with the support plan.

### Produces
Disability Support Plan. Adjustment Notification. Updated Student Record.

### Outcome
Students with disabilities receive agreed reasonable adjustments.

### Fails when
Medical Evidence is insufficient and the plan cannot be finalised, leaving adjustments unimplemented.

Name: Dispute Resolution
Documentation:
### Identity
Resolution of legal disputes, including litigation, arbitration, and settlement.

### Trigger
The arrival of a dispute notification or a legal claim.

### Consumes
Dispute Notification supplies the claim details and parties. Contract Agreement supplies the governing terms. Legal Precedent supplies relevant case law.

### Steps
The process assesses the merits of the dispute. It consults with affected departments. It appoints counsel and develops a strategy. It attempts negotiation or mediation. It prepares for litigation if necessary. It manages settlement discussions. It documents all actions and costs. If a settlement is reached, it is formalised. If not, it proceeds to hearing. The outcome is recorded.

### Produces
Dispute Resolution Record states the outcome and terms. Settlement Agreement records the agreed resolution. Legal Cost Record states the expenditure.

### Outcome
Disputes are resolved in the institution's interest, minimising cost and reputational damage.

### Fails when
A dispute is not managed, leading to an adverse judgment and significant financial loss.

Name: Domestic Student Recruitment
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of attracting and converting domestic prospective students into applicants.

### Trigger
The start of a recruitment cycle for the next academic year.

### Consumes
Recruitment Campaign Plan supplies the marketing messages. Prospectus supplies programme information. Enquiry List supplies prospective student contacts. Open Day Schedule supplies events.

### Steps
The recruitment team launches campaigns across chosen channels. Enquiries are captured from the Enquiry List. Prospective students are invited to open days. Application conversion activities are tracked. The campaign performance is reviewed against targets. Adjustments are made to underperforming channels. A lead nurturing sequence is triggered for warm prospects.

### Produces
Recruitment Campaign Report. Enquiry Response. Application Funnel Record.

### Outcome
Domestic prospective students are engaged and moved toward application.

### Fails when
The campaign fails to generate the planned number of enquiries and no adjustments reverse the trend.

Name: Employee Performance Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Performance appraisal and improvement management for employees. It sets objectives, reviews performance, and manages underperformance.

### Trigger
The arrival of a performance review cycle date or a performance concern notification.

### Consumes
Performance Objectives supply the agreed goals for the period. Performance Evidence Record supplies the observed outcomes and behaviours. Employee Record supplies the employment history and job role.

### Steps
The process agrees objectives at the start of the cycle. It holds mid-cycle check-ins. It gathers evidence and self-assessment. It conducts the formal review. It rates performance against the framework. It sets development actions for the next cycle. If underperformance is identified, an improvement plan is created. The plan's progress is monitored. If the improvement fails, it escalates to the formal capability procedure.

### Produces
Performance Review Record states the agreed rating and feedback. Development Plan states the training and support actions required. Underperformance Improvement Plan states the expected improvements and consequences.

### Outcome
Each employee has assessed performance and agreed development or improvement actions.

### Fails when
Performance concerns are not addressed, causing underperformance to continue and affect team delivery.

Name: Employee Support
Documentation:
### Identity
Provision of employee support services, including pastoral care, counselling, and reasonable adjustments.

### Trigger
The arrival of an employee support request or a referral from a manager.

### Consumes
Employee Support Request supplies the employee's issue and the support required. Employee Record supplies the employee's role and any known adjustments. Support Service Catalogue supplies the available internal and external services.

### Steps
The process assesses the request and determines the appropriate support. It assigns a case worker or refers to external services. It agrees an action plan with the employee. It monitors progress and follows up. It records the outcome. If the support involves a workplace adjustment, it coordinates with the manager and HR. It reviews cases periodically for closure.

### Produces
Employee Support Case Record states the support provided and outcome. Reasonable Adjustment Agreement states the agreed adjustment and review date. Referral Confirmation records the external service involved.

### Outcome
Employees receive effective support, and adjustments are in place to maintain their well-being and performance.

### Fails when
A support request is ignored or delayed, causing employee harm and potential legal claims.

Name: End User Computing
Documentation:
### Identity
Provision and support of end-user computing devices, including desktops, laptops, and software.

### Trigger
The arrival of a new starter equipment request or a user device fault report.

### Consumes
Device Request supplies the user's role and equipment needs. Device Inventory supplies the current devices and their location. Software Licence Record supplies the licences that can be installed.

### Steps
The process validates the device request against policy. It allocates a device or orders new. It configures the device with the required software. It deploys to the user. It provides support for faults. It patches and updates devices. It retires old devices. If a device is lost or stolen, it is remotely wiped and reported. All devices are tracked.

### Produces
Device Allocation Record states the user and device. Software Installation Record states the licensed software installed. Device Retirement Record states the disposal or wipe.

### Outcome
Users have working devices with licensed software, and the device estate is managed.

### Fails when
Device stock is insufficient or licences are exhausted, causing new starters to be without equipment.

Name: Enrolment Status Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of changing a student's enrolment status, including suspension, withdrawal, and return.

### Trigger
A Student Status Change Request submitted by the student or an academic authority.

### Consumes
Student Enrolment supplies the current status. Student Status Change Request supplies the requested new status and reason. Academic Policy supplies the rules for status changes. Funding Body Requirement supplies external constraints.

### Steps
The request is checked for completeness and supporting evidence. The reason is verified against Academic Policy. If the change is suspension or withdrawal, the student's funding body is notified. The change is approved by the academic registrar or delegated authority. The Student Enrolment record is updated with the new status. The Student Record is updated to reflect the change. A Confirmation of Status Change is issued to the student. If the request is refused, a refusal notice with reasons is issued.

### Produces
Updated Student Enrolment. Student Status Change Confirmation. Status Change Notice to funding body.

### Outcome
Enrolment statuses are accurate and formally approved.

### Fails when
The request lacks required evidence and the status cannot be updated, leaving the Student Record inconsistent.

Name: Enterprise Architecture
Documentation:
### Identity
This process defines the institution's current and target architectures and the roadmap that moves from one to the other, and it governs architectural compliance. It is the part of the capability that ensures technology and business change follow consistent architectural principles.

### Trigger
A major business change request or a new Strategic Plan signals a need to adjust the architecture, when current state architecture no longer supports the intended future state.

### Consumes
Current State Architecture supplies the baseline business processes, applications, data entities, and technology components. Business Requirements supply the capabilities and constraints demanded by the change. Technology Standards supply the approved patterns, platforms, and security constraints. Architecture Principles supply the decision rules from prior governance.

### Steps
First the process captures and validates the Current State Architecture for the domain affected. Then it analyses gaps between current state and the stated Business Requirements. It designs one or more Target Architecture options, evaluating each against Technology Standards and cost. It selects a preferred option and defines an Architecture Roadmap with transition states. It reviews each proposed project against the roadmap, approving or rejecting architectural deviations. When a project needs a deviation, it records the exception and its justification.

### Produces
Target Architecture records the agreed future state for the affected domain. Architecture Roadmap records the transition states, their sequence, and their dependencies. Architecture Decision records each approval or rejection of a proposed deviation.

### Outcome
All approved change initiatives are consistent with a single documented target architecture and a sequenced transition path.

### Fails when
The Current State Architecture is absent or incomplete, because the gap analysis cannot be performed and the resulting roadmap is based on unverified assumptions, causing downstream projects to deliver incompatible components.

Name: Enterprise Content Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of unstructured enterprise content, including documents, images, and multimedia, across its lifecycle.

### Trigger
The arrival of new content or a retention review date.

### Consumes
Content Item supplies the new or changed document. Content Classification Scheme supplies the metadata and security classification. Retention Schedule supplies the required retention periods.

### Steps
The process captures and classifies content. It applies metadata and security controls. It stores the content in the enterprise repository. It manages versioning and access. It runs retention and disposal rules. It migrates content when systems change. It provides search and retrieval. If content is misfiled, it is corrected.

### Produces
Content Item Metadata Record states the classification and ownership. Retention Disposal Decision states whether to keep, archive, or delete. Content Repository Index updates the search index.

### Outcome
Enterprise content is organised, secure, and available for its required retention period.

### Fails when
Content is not classified correctly, causing over-retention under GDPR or loss of important records.

Name: Environmental Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of environmental performance, including energy, waste, and regulatory compliance across the estate.

### Trigger
The arrival of a statutory environmental return date or a scheduled sustainability performance review.

### Consumes
Energy Consumption Record supplies utility usage and cost data. Waste Disposal Record supplies waste stream volumes and disposal routes. Environmental Compliance Requirement supplies the legal limits and reporting duties.

### Steps
The process collects and validates energy and waste data. It measures performance against environmental targets and legal limits. It identifies deviations and investigates their cause. It implements corrective measures through Facilities Work Orders. It prepares and submits statutory returns. It tracks progress on sustainability initiatives. If a target is missed, a corrective action is assigned to the responsible area. Annual performance is reported to governance.

### Produces
Environmental Performance Report states the measured performance against targets. Statutory Environmental Return supplies the data required by regulators. Corrective Action Request states the work needed to address a deviation.

### Outcome
The institution's environmental impacts are measured, reported, and corrected within legal and policy limits.

### Fails when
Energy or waste data is missing or inaccurate, causing statutory returns to be late or incorrect and risking compliance breach.

Name: Estate Development & Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Strategic and project-based development of the estate, including new buildings, major refurbishments, and space strategy.

### Trigger
The arrival of an Estate Strategy requirement or a Building Condition Survey that identifies major works.

### Consumes
Estate Strategy supplies the long-term spatial and capital priorities. Building Condition Survey supplies the life-cycle defects and compliance risks for existing assets. Capital Budget supplies the funding envelope for approved projects.

### Steps
The process prioritises projects against the Estate Strategy and condition data. It develops project briefs and feasibility studies. It obtains planning and statutory approvals. It procures design and construction services. It delivers the project through stage gates, monitoring scope, cost, and programme. It manages handover and snagging. It updates the estate asset register and condition data. If a project overruns, the contingency or reallocation decision is made at the stage gate. Completed projects are reviewed for benefits.

### Produces
Estate Development Plan states the approved programme of projects and their phasing. Project Business Case states the justification, cost, and expected benefits for a single project. Asset Register Update records the new or changed building asset.

### Outcome
The estate is developed in accordance with strategy, maintaining building condition and capacity within capital limits.

### Fails when
Capital funding is withdrawn or planning consent is refused, causing approved projects to stop and building condition to decline.

Name: Event Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of institutional events, including planning, logistics, safety, and evaluation.

### Trigger
The arrival of an event proposal or confirmed booking.

### Consumes
Event Proposal supplies the purpose, date, and expected numbers. Venue Booking Confirmation supplies the confirmed room and facilities. Event Risk Assessment supplies the identified hazards.

### Steps
The process plans the event logistics. It coordinates suppliers and internal services. It manages invitations and registrations. It runs the event. It ensures health and safety compliance. It collects feedback. It reports on outcomes. If the event exceeds capacity, it plans an overflow or reschedules. It closes the event file.

### Produces
Event Plan states the schedule and responsibilities. Event Registration List records attendees. Event Feedback Report records attendee satisfaction.

### Outcome
The institution delivers safe, successful events that meet their objectives.

### Fails when
A key supplier fails or a safety incident occurs, causing the event to be cancelled or damaged.

Name: Expenditure Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Processing of supplier invoices, expense claims, and other payments from receipt to payment.

### Trigger
The arrival of a Supplier Invoice or Expense Claim.

### Consumes
Supplier Invoice supplies the amount, supplier, and goods or services received. Purchase Order supplies the authorised commitment to match against. Goods Receipt Note supplies confirmation of delivery or service completion.

### Steps
The process matches the invoice to the purchase order and goods receipt. It checks for price and quantity deviations. It routes unmatched invoices for approval. It applies tax and discount terms. It schedules payment by due date. It posts the invoice to the ledger. It handles duplicate and disputed invoices. If a match fails, the invoice is queried with the supplier and held. Once resolved, it is released for payment.

### Produces
Payment Batch states the invoices approved for payment in a run. Supplier Invoice Record records the posting and payment status. Supplier Query states the missing or incorrect information that must be resolved before payment.

### Outcome
Supplier invoices are paid accurately and on time, with only authorised expenditure released.

### Fails when
Purchase order matching cannot be completed and the supplier query is not resolved, causing payments to stop and supplier service to be withdrawn.

Name: Financial Advisory
Documentation:
### Identity
Financial advice and analysis to support institutional decision-making, investment appraisal, and financial planning.

### Trigger
The arrival of a request for financial analysis or an investment proposal.

### Consumes
Investment Proposal supplies the project financials and expected returns. Financial Data Set supplies current and projected financial position. Costing Model supplies the standard costing methods and assumptions.

### Steps
The process scopes the analysis required. It gathers relevant financial data and validates its completeness. It constructs or updates a costing model. It performs sensitivity and scenario analysis. It prepares an advice paper with recommendations and risks. It presents the advice to the decision-maker. It responds to follow-up queries and revises the analysis. If the proposal is approved, handover to budget and project teams occurs.

### Produces
Financial Analysis Report states the findings, assumptions, and recommended option. Investment Appraisal Decision records the approval or rejection. Costing Model Update records any change to costing assumptions.

### Outcome
The institution makes investment and financial decisions from analysed, evidence-based advice.

### Fails when
Financial data is incomplete or the costing model is not validated, causing poor investment decisions and financial loss.

Name: Financial Reporting
Documentation:
### Identity
Statutory and management financial reporting, including month-end, year-end, and preparation of Financial Statements.

### Trigger
The arrival of a period-end closing date or a statutory filing deadline.

### Consumes
General Ledger Trial Balance supplies the closing balances for all accounts. Journal Entry supplies adjustments and accruals. Reporting Standard supplies the accounting rules to apply.

### Steps
The process performs pre-close checks and reconciliations. It posts adjusting journal entries for accruals, prepayments, and corrections. It runs the trial balance and validates balances. It prepares the Financial Statements. It obtains audit evidence and responds to audit queries. It submits final statements to governance and regulators. It closes the period and opens the next. If a reconciliation fails, the account is investigated before continuing.

### Produces
Financial Statements state the institution's position and performance for the period. Management Accounts Pack supplies internal performance reports. Period Close Confirmation records the closed period and any outstanding items.

### Outcome
The institution's financial position is reported accurately and on time to stakeholders.

### Fails when
Year-end adjustments cannot be posted because supporting documentation is missing, causing a late filing and audit qualification.

Name: Food & Retail Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of food and retail outlets on campus, including catering, shops, and vending.

### Trigger
The arrival of a daily operations schedule or a supplier delivery.

### Consumes
Food Order supplies the required ingredients and supplies. Sales Transaction Record supplies the daily sales. Health and Safety Standard supplies the hygiene requirements.

### Steps
The process orders stock. It manages deliveries. It prepares and serves food. It operates retail outlets. It manages staffing. It ensures food safety compliance. It reconciles daily sales. It handles customer feedback. If a food safety issue occurs, it closes the outlet and investigates.

### Produces
Daily Sales Report states the revenue and stock used. Food Safety Audit Record records the hygiene check. Supplier Delivery Note records received goods.

### Outcome
The campus community has safe and convenient food and retail services.

### Fails when
A food safety breach occurs, causing illness and temporary closure.

Name: Government Relationship Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of relationships with central and local government bodies. It tracks policy, responds to consultations, and secures permissions.

### Trigger
The arrival of a Government Policy document or a government consultation deadline.

### Consumes
Government Policy Document supplies the policy change and its implications. Consultation Request supplies the specific questions and response date. Institutional Position Paper supplies the institution's agreed stance.

### Steps
The process reviews the policy document or consultation. It assesses impact on institutional strategy and operations. It drafts a response or position. It obtains internal approval from the relevant executive. It submits the response by the deadline. It briefs senior leaders on the position. It monitors subsequent government announcements. If the policy is adversarial, an advocacy plan is developed. It records all interactions.

### Produces
Government Consultation Response states the institution's formal answer. Policy Impact Assessment records the effect on institutional operations. Advocacy Plan states the actions to influence decision-makers.

### Outcome
The institution understands and responds to government policy, protecting its interests and meeting consultation duties.

### Fails when
A consultation deadline is missed, causing the institution's views to be excluded and policy decisions to be made without its input.

Name: Graduation Eligibility Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of determining which students have met all requirements for an award.

### Trigger
The Results Board publishes final Student Results Records for the year.

### Consumes
Student Results Record supplies the final marks. Programme Requirements Register supplies the required credits and conditions. Student Record supplies the students to check. Award Regulations supplies classification rules.

### Steps
Each student's completed credits are compared to the Programme Requirements Register. Students meeting all requirements are added to the Graduation Candidate List. Students missing credits are flagged for resit or appeal. The candidate list is checked by the Awards Board. The board confirms the Award Classification using Award Regulations. The confirmed list is approved.

### Produces
Graduation Candidate List. Award Classification. Graduation Eligibility Decision.

### Outcome
Every student's eligibility for award is determined and classified.

### Fails when
Programme Requirements Register is ambiguous and the Awards Board cannot confirm classifications, delaying graduation.

Name: Graduation Event Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of planning and delivering the graduation ceremonies.

### Trigger
The Graduation Candidate List is approved.

### Consumes
Graduation Candidate List supplies the number of graduands. Venue Booking supplies the location and date. Academic Calendar supplies the ceremony dates. Academic Dress Order supplies the gowns.

### Steps
The ceremony schedule is set. Graduands are allocated to ceremonies. Academic dress is arranged. Tickets are issued. The ceremony is rehearsed. On the day, graduands are processed and the ceremony is conducted. A photographer records the event. Certificates are distributed at the ceremony or after.

### Produces
Graduation Ceremony Schedule. Graduation Ceremony Record. Ticket Allocation.

### Outcome
Graduation ceremonies are delivered for all eligible graduands.

### Fails when
Venue capacity is exceeded and no additional ceremony can be scheduled, leaving some graduands unable to attend.

Name: Graduation Record Certificate Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of producing and issuing Awarded Degree Certificates and Graduate Records.

### Trigger
The Awards Board confirms final awards.

### Consumes
Award Classification supplies the final award and class. Student Record supplies the personal details. Certificate Template supplies the format. Transcript Template supplies the academic history format.

### Steps
The certificate is produced with the graduate's name, award and classification. The Graduate Record is prepared with the academic transcript. Both are checked for accuracy. The certificate is signed and sealed. The items are issued to the graduate in person or by post. A digital badge is issued where applicable.

### Produces
Awarded Degree Certificate. Graduate Record. Digital Badge.

### Outcome
Graduates receive verified credentials confirming their award.

### Fails when
The Student Record has incorrect personal details and no correction is made before printing, causing invalid certificates.

Name: Health & Safety
Documentation:
### Identity
Institutional health and safety management, including risk assessment, training, accident reporting, and regulatory compliance.

### Trigger
The arrival of an Accident Report or a scheduled safety audit date.

### Consumes
Accident Report supplies the incident details and persons affected. Risk Assessment supplies the identified hazards and controls for a workplace activity. Safety Audit Schedule supplies the planned audit dates and scope.

### Steps
The process investigates accidents and near misses. It identifies root causes and recommends corrective actions. It reviews risk assessments for affected activities. It schedules and delivers safety training. It conducts audits and inspections. Non-conformities are recorded and assigned to responsible managers. The status of corrective actions is monitored until closure. Annual safety performance is reported to governance.

### Produces
Accident Investigation Record states the root cause and recommended actions. Corrective Action Request states the work required to close a non-conformity. Safety Audit Report records the findings and compliance status.

### Outcome
The institution's activities are controlled by current risk assessments and closed safety actions.

### Fails when
A serious accident occurs and corrective actions are not implemented, causing repeated harm and regulatory enforcement.

Name: Health Care Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of on-campus health services for students and staff, including appointments, treatment, and referrals.

### Trigger
The arrival of a healthcare appointment request or a urgent health need.

### Consumes
Appointment Request supplies the patient and symptoms. Patient Record supplies the medical history. Clinical Referral Pathway supplies the options for further care.

### Steps
The process triages the request. It books an appointment. It provides clinical assessment and treatment. It prescribes or refers. It manages follow-up. It records the consultation. It manages urgent presentations immediately. It complies with confidentiality and regulatory standards. It reports on service usage.

### Produces
Clinical Consultation Record states the assessment and treatment. Prescription Record states the medication issued. Referral Letter states the onward referral.

### Outcome
Patients receive appropriate healthcare and the campus remains a healthy environment.

### Fails when
No clinician is available, causing an urgent case to be referred off-site with delay.

Name: High Performance Computing
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of the high-performance computing facility, including capacity, access, and research support.

### Trigger
The arrival of a research computing project request or a capacity utilization review.

### Consumes
Research Computing Request supplies the computational needs and duration. HPC Capacity Record supplies the available nodes and storage. User Access Request supplies the applicant's eligibility and project.

### Steps
The process reviews the project against technical feasibility. It allocates computing time and storage. It grants user access. It monitors jobs and capacity. It supports users with code and environment issues. It schedules maintenance windows. It charges back usage where applicable. It plans capacity upgrades. If a job exceeds allocation, it is queued or rejected.

### Produces
HPC Allocation Record states the granted compute and storage. User Access Grant states the user's permissions. HPC Usage Report records consumption and costs.

### Outcome
Researchers have access to HPC resources, and capacity is managed within limits.

### Fails when
Capacity is oversubscribed, causing research jobs to fail or be delayed, impacting research outputs.

Name: Housing Advice
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of advising students on accommodation options and issues.

### Trigger
A student requests housing advice.

### Consumes
Student Enrolment supplies the student status. Accommodation Register supplies available housing. Tenancy Agreement supplies contract issues. Legal Rights Guide supplies the rights information.

### Steps
The advisor assesses the student's situation. Options are presented. If needed, the student is referred to external services. The advice is recorded. A tenancy check is performed. Dispute resolution guidance is provided.

### Produces
Housing Advice Record. External Referral.

### Outcome
Students receive housing information and referrals.

### Fails when
The Accommodation Register is empty and no options can be provided.

Name: ICT Service Support
Documentation:
### Identity
Service desk and incident management for ICT services, including request fulfilment, incident resolution, and change management.

### Trigger
The arrival of a Service Request or Incident Report from a user.

### Consumes
Service Request supplies the user's requirement, such as access or a new service. Incident Report supplies the service failure and impact. Knowledge Base Article supplies known solutions.

### Steps
The process categorises and prioritises the request or incident. It attempts first-line resolution. If unresolved, it escalates to specialist teams. It updates the user on progress. It applies a workaround if a permanent fix is not immediate. It closes the ticket after user confirmation. It documents the resolution in the knowledge base. It identifies recurring incidents for problem management.

### Produces
Resolved Incident Record states the root cause and fix. Service Request Fulfilment Record states the delivered service. Knowledge Base Article Update records a new solution.

### Outcome
Users' ICT issues and requests are resolved within agreed service levels, and knowledge is captured.

### Fails when
A major incident cannot be resolved, causing prolonged system outage and widespread user inability to work.

Name: Identity & Access Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of digital identities, access rights, and authentication across systems.

### Trigger
The arrival of a new account request or an access change request.

### Consumes
Account Request supplies the user and required systems. Access Policy supplies the role-based permissions. Identity Record supplies the current accounts and rights.

### Steps
The process validates the request against the access policy. It provisions the account or modifies access. It applies least privilege. It enforces multi-factor authentication. It reviews access periodically. It removes access upon departure or role change. It logs all changes. If a request is high-risk, it requires extra approval. Deprovisioning is immediate on termination.

### Produces
User Account Grant states the new or changed access. Access Review Report records the periodic audit of rights. Deprovisioning Confirmation records the removal of access.

### Outcome
Only authorised users have access to systems, and access is removed promptly when no longer needed.

### Fails when
An account is not deprovisioned, allowing an ex-employee to access systems, causing a security breach.

Name: Income Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of all income streams, including student fees, research grants, and commercial income, from receipt to recognition.

### Trigger
The arrival of an income receipt or an income schedule requirement.

### Consumes
Income Receipt supplies the amount, source, and account code. Income Schedule supplies the planned timing and amount for each income stream. Student Fee Payment supplies specific payment for student fees.

### Steps
The process matches income receipts to outstanding invoices or agreements. It allocates receipts to the correct account code and cost centre. It reconciles the income ledger to bank records. It recognises deferred income where revenue relates to future periods. It follows up on overdue invoices. It handles credit notes and refunds. If a receipt is unallocated, it is queried and resolved before posting. Periodic income reports are prepared.

### Produces
Income Allocation Record states which invoice or account each receipt was applied to. Income Reconciliation Report records the match between ledger and bank. Overdue Invoice Reminder states the amount and due date for outstanding payments.

### Outcome
All income is accurately recorded, recognised in the correct period, and pursued when overdue.

### Fails when
Income receipts cannot be matched to an invoice, causing unallocated cash and incorrect revenue recognition.

Name: Industry Relationship Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of relationships with industry partners, employers, and commercial collaborators.

### Trigger
The arrival of an industry partnership enquiry or a scheduled partnership review.

### Consumes
Partnership Proposal supplies the proposed collaboration and objectives. Industry Contact Record supplies the history and status of the relationship. Institutional Capability Statement supplies what the institution can offer.

### Steps
The process scopes the partnership opportunity. It matches institutional capabilities with partner needs. It negotiates partnership terms. It secures internal approval. It establishes a partnership register entry. It manages ongoing communication and joint projects. It reviews partnership performance annually. If the partnership underperforms, it is renegotiated or terminated. It records all outcomes.

### Produces
Partnership Agreement states the mutual obligations and scope of collaboration. Partnership Review Report records the performance assessment. Partnership Register Update records the current status.

### Outcome
The institution builds and maintains productive industry relationships that deliver mutual value.

### Fails when
A partner withdraws or the partnership fails to produce agreed outcomes, causing lost investment and reputational damage.

Name: Information & Data Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Data governance and management of institutional data assets, including data quality, standards, and master data.

### Trigger
The arrival of a new data asset or a data quality issue report.

### Consumes
Data Asset Inventory supplies the current data assets and owners. Data Quality Issue Report supplies the specific data errors. Data Standard supplies the required formats and definitions.

### Steps
The process registers new data assets. It assigns data owners and stewards. It defines and enforces data standards. It monitors data quality. It corrects data quality issues with the owners. It maintains the business glossary. It reviews data access and usage. If a data quality issue is critical, it is escalated. It reports on data governance maturity.

### Produces
Data Asset Register Update records the new or changed data asset. Data Quality Correction Record states the fix applied. Data Standard Update records a change to definitions.

### Outcome
The institution's data is trustworthy, well-defined, and managed by accountable owners.

### Fails when
Data quality issues accumulate without correction, causing downstream analytics and reporting to be unreliable.

Name: Information & Data Security Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Information and data security management, including risk assessment, security controls, and incident response.

### Trigger
The arrival of a security risk assessment request or a security incident report.

### Consumes
Security Risk Assessment supplies the identified threats and vulnerabilities. Security Incident Report supplies the incident details and affected assets. Security Policy supplies the required controls and procedures.

### Steps
The process assesses security risks and assigns risk owners. It implements security controls. It monitors for security events. It responds to incidents, containing and eradicating threats. It conducts root cause analysis. It reports to governance. It updates the risk register. If an incident involves personal data, it assesses breach notification requirements. It reviews controls after the incident.

### Produces
Security Risk Register Update records the current risks and controls. Security Incident Response Record states the actions taken and recovery. Security Breach Notification records the notification to the regulator or data subjects.

### Outcome
The institution protects its information assets and responds effectively to security incidents.

### Fails when
A security control is missing, allowing a data breach that causes financial and reputational damage.

Name: Information Analytics
Documentation:
### Identity
Advanced data analytics, including predictive modelling, business intelligence, and insight generation.

### Trigger
The arrival of an analytics request or a scheduled analytics model refresh.

### Consumes
Analytics Request supplies the business question and data required. Prepared Data Set supplies the cleaned and transformed data. Analytics Model supplies the existing model logic and parameters.

### Steps
The process defines the analysis objective. It prepares the data set. It builds or refines the model. It validates the model. It runs the analysis and interprets results. It presents insights to the decision-maker. It monitors model performance. If the model drifts, it is retrained. It documents assumptions.

### Produces
Analytics Report states the findings, method, and recommended actions. Model Update records the new version and performance. Presentation Deck supplies the communicated insights.

### Outcome
The institution uses data-driven insights for better decisions.

### Fails when
The model is not validated against current data, causing misleading insights and poor decisions.

Name: Information Collection Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Collection of information from internal and external sources, including forms, surveys, and automated feeds.

### Trigger
The arrival of a collection requirement or a data submission deadline.

### Consumes
Collection Requirement supplies the data fields and sources. Data Collection Form supplies the template for respondents. Existing Data Source supplies prior data available internally.

### Steps
The process defines the collection method and coverage. It designs or configures the collection form. It launches the collection. It validates incoming data for completeness and eligibility. It stores the data in the appropriate repository. It follows up non-response. It closes the collection. If data quality issues are found, they are reported back to the source.

### Produces
Collected Data Set states the gathered data and its quality status. Data Collection Validation Report records the checks and issues. Non-Response Follow-Up List states the outstanding submissions.

### Outcome
The institution has complete and valid data for the intended purpose.

### Fails when
Response rates are insufficient, causing biased or incomplete data for analysis.

Name: Information Search & Discovery
Documentation:
### Identity
Search and discovery across institutional information, including enterprise search and metadata-driven retrieval.

### Trigger
The arrival of a search query or an index refresh requirement.

### Consumes
Search Query supplies the user's terms and filters. Search Index supplies the indexed content and metadata. Content Classification Scheme supplies the tags and categories.

### Steps
The process receives the search query. It expands and disambiguates the terms. It matches against the search index. It ranks results by relevance and security. It returns the results to the user. It logs usage and failed searches. It updates the index periodically. If results are poor, it refines the indexing rules.

### Produces
Search Results Set states the returned items. Search Usage Log records the queries and outcomes. Index Update Record states the refresh.

### Outcome
Users find the information they need quickly, and search logs inform index improvements.

### Fails when
The search index is outdated, causing users to miss critical information.

Name: Infrastructure Lifecycle Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of the ICT infrastructure lifecycle, including servers, networks, and data centres.

### Trigger
The arrival of a capacity shortfall or a hardware end-of-life notification.

### Consumes
Infrastructure Inventory supplies the current hardware and software versions. Capacity Report supplies the utilisation and growth trends. Technology Roadmap supplies the planned infrastructure standards.

### Steps
The process assesses current capacity and performance. It plans upgrades or replacements. It procures new hardware. It installs and configures. It tests and migrates workloads. It monitors post-migration. It retires old hardware. It updates documentation. If a failure occurs, it executes the disaster recovery plan.

### Produces
Infrastructure Build Record states the new components installed. Capacity Upgrade Plan states the planned improvements. Decommissioning Record states the removal of old hardware.

### Outcome
The infrastructure is current, resilient, and sized to meet demand.

### Fails when
Capacity planning is unreliable, causing unexpected hardware failure or inability to support new applications.

Name: Insurance Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of insurance policies, claims, and risk assessments for institutional assets and activities.

### Trigger
The arrival of a renewal date for an insurance policy or an insurance claim.

### Consumes
Insurance Policy supplies the coverage terms, limits, and exclusions. Insurance Claim supplies the incident, loss, and amount claimed. Risk Register supplies the institutional risks that insurance may cover.

### Steps
The process reviews insurance needs against the risk register and asset values. It obtains quotes and selects insurers. It issues and maintains policies. It handles claims by collecting documentation and submitting to insurers. It tracks claim progress and settlements. It records incidents that may give rise to claims. It reviews claims history to adjust coverage. If a claim is disputed, it escalates to legal. It confirms renewal or terminates policies.

### Produces
Insurance Policy Record states the current coverage and expiry. Insurance Claim File records the claim status and settlement. Claim Settlement Statement states the amount paid by the insurer.

### Outcome
The institution has adequate insurance coverage and legitimate claims are settled.

### Fails when
A claim is denied because a policy condition was not met, causing an uninsured loss and budget impact.

Name: Internal Audit & Reporting
Documentation:
### Identity
This process provides independent assurance over the institution's governance, risk management, and control processes through planned audits. It is the part of the capability that verifies the effectiveness of internal controls.

### Trigger
The approval of the Annual Audit Plan triggers the process, when the audit team is resourced and the audit has been scheduled.

### Consumes
Audit Plan supplies the list of audits, scope, and timing. Control Framework supplies the expected controls and their design. Evidence Record supplies the operational records needed to test control operation.

### Steps
First the process prepares the audit by defining the audit objectives and test procedures. It then performs fieldwork, testing the control framework against evidence. It records any deviations as draft audit findings. It holds a closing meeting with management to confirm the facts. It drafts the Internal Audit Report with findings and recommendations. It obtains management's response, including action owners and due dates. It issues the final report to the audit committee. It then follows up at agreed intervals to verify completion of actions.

### Produces
Audit Findings record each control weakness, its impact, and its severity. Internal Audit Report records the audit objectives, methodology, findings, and management responses. Corrective Action Plan records the agreed actions, owners, and due dates.

### Outcome
The governing body and management have an independent assessment of the control environment, with agreed corrective actions for every identified weakness.

### Fails when
Management does not respond to draft findings, because the Internal Audit Report cannot be issued and no Corrective Action Plan is created, leaving control weaknesses unaddressed.

Name: Internal Communications
Documentation:
### Identity
Internal communications to staff and students, including announcements, newsletters, and notices.

### Trigger
The arrival of an internal communication request from leadership.

### Consumes
Communication Request supplies the message and audience. Audience List supplies the distribution list. Channel Configuration Record supplies the available channels.

### Steps
The process reviews the request. It drafts the message. It obtains approval. It distributes via selected channels. It monitors readership. It answers questions. It archives the communication. If the message is sensitive, it applies access controls. It reports on engagement.

### Produces
Internal Communication Item states the distributed message. Distribution Confirmation records who received it. Engagement Report records opens and clicks.

### Outcome
The internal community is informed about institutional matters.

### Fails when
A critical message is not distributed to all intended staff, causing confusion and non-compliance.

Name: Internal Stakeholder Relationship Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of relationships with internal stakeholders, including academic and administrative units, to ensure alignment and communication.

### Trigger
The arrival of an internal stakeholder request or a scheduled stakeholder engagement plan.

### Consumes
Internal Stakeholder Request supplies the need or issue to be addressed. Stakeholder Map supplies the list of internal groups and their interests. Communication Channel Record supplies the preferred and available channels.

### Steps
The process identifies the relevant internal stakeholder groups. It plans engagement activities and messages. It delivers communications and meetings. It collects feedback. It resolves any issues raised. It updates the stakeholder map with new contacts or preferences. It reports on engagement outcomes. If a request requires action, it is assigned to the relevant unit.

### Produces
Stakeholder Engagement Plan states the engagement activities and schedule. Engagement Feedback Summary records the points raised. Internal Communication Item delivers the message to the stakeholder group.

### Outcome
Internal stakeholders are informed and aligned with institutional plans, and their issues are managed.

### Fails when
A key internal stakeholder group is not consulted on a decision affecting them, causing resistance and delayed implementation.

Name: International Student Recruitment
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of recruiting international students, including agent management and visa-related attraction.

### Trigger
The international recruitment cycle begins.

### Consumes
International Recruitment Plan supplies target markets and channels. Student Recruitment Agent Contract supplies agent obligations. Country Entry Requirements supplies visa and qualification information. Prospectus supplies programme information.

### Steps
The plan is executed in target markets. Agents are briefed and provided with Prospectus materials. Enquiries are handled and converted to Student Applications. Visa requirements are communicated. The agent performance is tracked against Student Recruitment Agent Contract. Conversion rates are monitored. Underperforming agents are reviewed. A country-level report is produced.

### Produces
International Recruitment Campaign Report. Agent Performance Report. Student Application.

### Outcome
International applicants are recruited within planned numbers and agent performance is measured.

### Fails when
Visa policy changes reduce conversion and no alternative markets are identified, missing intake targets.

Name: Knowledge Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Knowledge management, including capturing, organising, and sharing institutional knowledge.

### Trigger
The arrival of new knowledge from a completed project or a knowledge request.

### Consumes
Knowledge Item supplies the new content or lesson learned. Knowledge Taxonomy supplies the classification structure. Knowledge Request supplies the user's specific information need.

### Steps
The process captures knowledge from projects, incidents, and experts. It reviews and validates the knowledge. It classifies it in the taxonomy. It stores in the knowledge base. It publishes and promotes. It answers knowledge requests. It reviews knowledge for currency. Retired knowledge is archived. If knowledge is outdated, it is updated or removed.

### Produces
Knowledge Article states the validated knowledge. Knowledge Base Update records the added or changed entry. Knowledge Request Response supplies the answer to the requester.

### Outcome
The institution leverages its collective knowledge, reducing rework and improving decisions.

### Fails when
Critical knowledge resides only in individuals' heads and is lost when they leave.

Name: Legal & Legislative Compliance
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of legal and legislative compliance, including horizon scanning, impact assessment, and adherence monitoring.

### Trigger
The arrival of new legislation or a compliance audit finding.

### Consumes
Legislation Update supplies the new or changed law. Compliance Register supplies the current obligations and controls. Audit Finding supplies the identified non-compliance.

### Steps
The process scans for new legislation affecting the institution. It assesses impact. It updates the compliance register. It assigns compliance owners. It monitors compliance controls. It reports to governance. It remediates audit findings. It provides training on new requirements. If a breach is found, it escalates to legal. The register is reviewed regularly.

### Produces
Compliance Impact Assessment states the effect of new law. Compliance Register Update records changes. Compliance Remediation Plan states the actions to close findings.

### Outcome
The institution meets its legal obligations and manages compliance risks.

### Fails when
New legislation is missed, causing a breach and enforcement action.

Name: Legal Advisory
Documentation:
### Identity
Provision of legal advice to internal clients on routine and complex matters.

### Trigger
The arrival of a legal query from a department.

### Consumes
Legal Query supplies the facts and question. Policy Document supplies the internal rules. Legislation Database supplies the applicable laws.

### Steps
The process reviews the query and gathers facts. It researches the legal position. It drafts advice. It reviews with a senior lawyer. It issues the advice. It discusses implications with the client. It updates the advice log. It follows up on material changes. If the matter is complex, it escalates to external counsel.

### Produces
Legal Advice Note states the recommendation and basis. External Counsel Instructions records the engagement for external advice. Legal Advice Log Update records the advice given.

### Outcome
The institution receives sound legal advice, enabling compliant decisions.

### Fails when
A legal query is not answered before the decision deadline, causing either a poor decision or a lost opportunity.

Name: Library Collection Access Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of access to library collections, including loans, reading rooms, and access permissions.

### Trigger
The arrival of a library loan request or an access permission request.

### Consumes
Library Loan Request supplies the item and borrower. Borrower Record supplies the user's eligibility and standing. Collection Item Record supplies the availability and location.

### Steps
The process verifies borrower eligibility and any outstanding blocks. It checks item availability. It issues the loan and sets due date. It manages renewals and returns. It handles reserves and recalls. It manages reading room access. It applies fines for overdue items. It reports on usage. If an item is not returned, it follows the lost items policy.

### Produces
Library Loan Record states the borrower, item, and due date. Access Grant states the permitted reading room use. Overdue Notice states the item and fine.

### Outcome
Library users can access collections within policy, and items circulate correctly.

### Fails when
A borrower has an unresolved block but is still granted access, causing loss of materials and unfairness.

Name: Library Collection Resource Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of library collection resources, including acquisition, cataloguing, and deselection.

### Trigger
The arrival of a collection development plan or an acquisition request.

### Consumes
Acquisition Request supplies the requested resource and justification. Collection Development Policy supplies the selection criteria. Current Holdings Record supplies the existing collection.

### Steps
The process evaluates the request against policy and budget. It acquires the resource. It catalogues and classifies it. It adds it to the library system. It promotes new acquisitions. It monitors usage. It deselects low-use or damaged items. It updates holdings records. If an item is not available through normal suppliers, an interlibrary loan or alternative is considered.

### Produces
Library Item Catalogue Record states the new item and metadata. Acquisition Order states the purchase order for the resource. Deselection List states the items removed.

### Outcome
The library collection is current, relevant, and within budget.

### Fails when
Acquisition requests exceed budget, causing the collection to fall behind user needs.

Name: Library Membership Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of library memberships, including registration, entitlement, and expiry.

### Trigger
The arrival of a membership application or a renewal request.

### Consumes
Membership Application supplies the applicant's details and status. Entitlement Policy supplies who is entitled and the fees. Membership Record supplies the existing membership.

### Steps
The process verifies the applicant's entitlement. It collects any fee. It creates or renews the membership. It issues a library card. It records the expiry date. It manages changes to status. It cancels membership on departure. If the applicant is not entitled, a guest or fee-paying option may be offered. It reviews membership data regularly.

### Produces
Library Membership Card states the member and expiry. Membership Record Update states the current status. Fee Receipt records any payment.

### Outcome
The institution has an accurate membership base with correct entitlements.

### Fails when
An ineligible person receives membership, creating security and accountability problems.

Name: Mail Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Daily processing of inbound and outbound institutional mail, parcels, and courier items.

### Trigger
The arrival of inbound post or a request for an outbound mailing.

### Consumes
Inbound Mail Item supplies the recipient address and contents. Outbound Mailing Request supplies the sender, destination, and service required. Mailroom Capacity Record supplies the handling capacity for peak volumes.

### Steps
The process sorts inbound mail by department and urgency. It records registered and tracked items. It distributes mail to internal locations. It processes outbound requests, checking address and service. It franks or arranges courier collection. It logs tracking numbers and delivery confirmations. Undeliverable items are returned to sender or held for collection.

### Produces
Mail Delivery Log records each item's receipt and internal delivery. Outbound Dispatch Record states the date and service used for each outbound item. Undeliverable Mail Notice informs the sender of non-delivery.

### Outcome
Mail is processed and delivered within agreed timescales, with tracking information available for each item.

### Fails when
A mail item is lost or misdelivered, causing missed deadlines or confidential information exposure.

Name: Manage Research Relationships
Documentation:
### Identity
Work here establishes and sustains relationships with external research partners, funders, and stakeholders so that collaborative activity is tracked and obligations are met.

### Trigger
The arrival of a Collaboration Request from an external organisation, when no active Research Partnership Agreement covers that organisation for the proposed activity.

### Consumes
Collaboration Request supplies the proposed activity, partner details, and desired outcomes. Research Relationship Register supplies the history of past interactions and current agreements with the partner. Stakeholder Engagement Record supplies the last recorded contact and any outstanding commitments. Research Partnership Agreement supplies the terms and obligations when an existing agreement covers the relationship.

### Steps
The Collaboration Request is checked against the Research Relationship Register to identify existing links. If an active Research Partnership Agreement exists, the request is routed to the agreement owner for renewal or amendment. If no agreement exists, the process drafts a new Research Partnership Agreement covering data sharing, intellectual property, and publication rights. The draft is approved by legal and the partner before being signed. After signing, the relationship is added to the Research Relationship Register. The process then sets a schedule for Stakeholder Engagement Records and produces a Partnership Performance Report at each annual review.

### Produces
Research Partnership Agreement: issued when the collaboration terms are signed, establishing the legal basis for joint work. Research Relationship Register: updated with the new or amended relationship, establishing the current relationship portfolio. Partnership Performance Report: issued at review points, establishing whether the collaboration is delivering against its objectives.

### Outcome
Every external research relationship is under a signed agreement and is actively reviewed.

### Fails when
The Stakeholder Engagement Record shows no contact for over a year and the process does not schedule a review; the partnership lapses and the Research Partnership Agreement is breached.

Name: Market Research
Documentation:
### Identity
Conducting market research to understand prospective students, employers, and stakeholders.

### Trigger
The arrival of a research brief or a scheduled market survey.

### Consumes
Research Brief supplies the questions and objectives. Sample Frame supplies the target population and contacts. Survey Instrument supplies the questionnaire.

### Steps
The process designs the research method. It selects the sample. It collects data. It cleans and analyses data. It prepares the report. It presents insights. It updates the research database. If response rates are low, it adjusts the sample or method. It archives the research.

### Produces
Market Research Report states the findings and implications. Data Set Update records the new data. Research Presentation supplies the key insights.

### Outcome
The institution understands its market and stakeholders, informing strategy and campaigns.

### Fails when
The sample is not representative, causing misleading insights and poor decisions.

Name: Marketing Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Overall marketing management, including planning, budgeting, and coordination of all marketing activities.

### Trigger
The arrival of the annual planning cycle or a marketing performance review.

### Consumes
Institutional Strategy supplies the goals and target market. Current Marketing Plan supplies the existing initiatives. Market Research Report supplies the insights and competitor data.

### Steps
The process develops the marketing strategy. It allocates budget. It plans the annual programme of activities. It monitors performance against KPIs. It adjusts the programme. It reports to governance. It coordinates with other communication teams. If a market opportunity arises, it reallocates budget. It reviews the plan quarterly.

### Produces
Marketing Plan states the annual objectives and activities. Marketing Budget Allocation states the spend by activity. Marketing Performance Report records results against targets.

### Outcome
The institution's marketing is strategic, coordinated, and measured.

### Fails when
Marketing activities are not aligned with recruitment targets, causing missed enrolment goals.

Name: Media Relations Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Media relations, including proactive press engagement, crisis communication, and media monitoring.

### Trigger
The arrival of a media enquiry or a scheduled press release date.

### Consumes
Media Enquiry supplies the journalist's question and deadline. Press Release Draft supplies the intended message. Media Contact List supplies the targeted outlets and journalists.

### Steps
The process logs the enquiry or press release request. It drafts or refines the response or press release. It obtains approval from the communications lead. It issues the response or release by the deadline. It monitors media coverage. It responds to follow-up questions. If the story is negative, it activates a crisis communication plan. It records all interactions and coverage.

### Produces
Press Release states the official institutional statement. Media Response states the answer given to an enquiry. Media Coverage Report records the resulting coverage and tone.

### Outcome
The institution's reputation is protected and promoted through managed media engagement.

### Fails when
A media enquiry receives no response or an unapproved statement is issued, causing reputational harm and loss of control.

Name: Merchandising
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of institutional merchandise, including design, production, stock, and sales.

### Trigger
The arrival of a merchandise product request or a stock replenishment trigger.

### Consumes
Merchandise Product Request supplies the item concept and approval. Stock Record supplies the current inventory. Sales Channel Order supplies the demand.

### Steps
The process designs or sources the product. It obtains brand approval. It places a production order. It receives and stores stock. It manages sales channels. It tracks stock levels and reorders. It prices products. It runs promotions. It discontinues slow items. It reports on sales and profit.

### Produces
Merchandise Product Line states the items and prices. Stock Replenishment Order states the quantity reordered. Merchandise Sales Report records revenue and margin.

### Outcome
The institution sells merchandise that supports the brand and generates income.

### Fails when
Stock is over- or under-supplied, causing lost sales or obsolescence.

Name: Module Selection Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of processing student module choices and producing module registrations.

### Trigger
The module selection window opens for the term.

### Consumes
Student Enrolment supplies the student's programme. Module Catalogue supplies available modules. Programme Requirements Register supplies compulsory and optional modules. Timetable supplies the session slots.

### Steps
The student submits a Module Selection Form. The choices are checked against programme requirements and prerequisites. Capacity checks are performed against module limits. Timetable conflicts are detected. Conflicts are identified and resolved. The Module Registration is created. The student is confirmed.

### Produces
Module Registration. Module Selection Confirmation.

### Outcome
Each student has a valid set of module registrations for the term.

### Fails when
The student selects too few credits and does not amend the form, leaving incomplete registration.

Name: Non Presence Based Teaching
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of delivering asynchronous or online teaching sessions.

### Trigger
The published Timetable indicates a non-presence based session.

### Consumes
Teaching Content Pack supplies the learning materials. Module Registration supplies the participant list. Virtual Learning Platform supplies the delivery environment. Accessibility Check supplies the compliance status.

### Steps
The materials are uploaded to the platform. The session is made available. Students are notified. Activity is monitored and recorded. Completion tracking is enabled. A reminder is sent to non-participants.

### Produces
Teaching Session Record. Student Participation Log. Completion Report.

### Outcome
Students access learning asynchronously as scheduled.

### Fails when
The Virtual Learning Platform is unavailable and the session cannot be delivered.

Name: Non-Academic Achievement Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of recording and recognising student achievements outside the formal curriculum.

### Trigger
A student submits evidence of a non-academic achievement.

### Consumes
Non-Academic Achievement Evidence supplies the activity details. Student Record supplies the student identity. Recognition Criteria supplies the rules for acceptance.

### Steps
The evidence is verified. The achievement is logged against the Student Record. If the achievement qualifies under Recognition Criteria, it is included in a supplementary transcript entry. The student is notified. A certificate of participation may be issued for certain achievements.

### Produces
Non-Academic Achievement Log. Updated Student Record. Supplementary Transcript Entry.

### Outcome
Student achievements beyond the curriculum are formally recorded.

### Fails when
The evidence cannot be verified and the achievement is not recorded.

Name: Non-Commercial Research Impact Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Work here collects and curates evidence of non-commercial research impact, turning that evidence into assessed case studies for external evaluation.

### Trigger
The arrival of an Impact Evidence submission from a researcher, when the evidence relates to a Research Output that is not under a commercialisation route.

### Consumes
Impact Evidence supplies the observed change, beneficiary, and supporting documentation. Research Output supplies the underpinning research that led to the impact. Impact Case Study supplies the template and required narrative fields for the external assessment. Impact Framework supplies the criteria and weighting used to judge whether evidence is sufficient.

### Steps
The Impact Evidence is logged and linked to the relevant Research Output. The process then assesses the evidence against the Impact Framework criteria for reach and significance. If the evidence fails the threshold, it is stored in the Impact Evidence Register but not progressed. If it passes, the process drafts an Impact Case Study using the supplied template, describing the research, the pathway, and the evidence. The draft is reviewed by the academic lead and, if revisions are required, returned. When approved, the Impact Case Study is submitted to the external assessment body. The process then records the submission in the Impact Evidence Register.

### Produces
Impact Case Study: issued when the evidence has been assembled and approved, establishing the institution's formal submission. Impact Evidence Register: updated with the evidence and its assessment status, establishing a searchable record of impact claims.

### Outcome
Non-commercial research impact is evidenced, assessed, and available for external evaluation.

### Fails when
The Impact Evidence is accepted without checking it against the Impact Framework and an Impact Case Study is submitted with insufficient significance; the external assessment rejects the case and the institution's impact score drops.

Name: Occupational Health
Documentation:
### Identity
Occupational health management, including referrals, assessments, and return-to-work plans.

### Trigger
The arrival of an occupational health referral or a return-to-work notification.

### Consumes
Occupational Health Referral supplies the reason and employee details. Employee Record supplies the job role and sickness history. Medical Assessment Report supplies the clinical findings and fitness for work.

### Steps
The process triages the referral. It arranges a medical assessment. It receives the assessment report and interprets its impact on the employee's role. It arranges the workplace adjustments or return-to-work plan. It monitors the employee's progress. If the employee is unfit, it manages long-term absence procedures. It reviews the case at defined intervals. It records all decisions.

### Produces
Occupational Health Report states the employee's fitness and recommendations. Return to Work Plan states the phased return or adjustments. Workplace Adjustment Record states the changes made to the job.

### Outcome
Employees are supported through health issues and return to work in a managed way, reducing absence and risk.

### Fails when
Occupational health advice is not acted upon, causing an employee to return too early and suffer further harm.

Name: Offer, Acceptance & Quota Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
The work of converting assessed applications into offers and acceptances while managing intake quotas.

### Trigger
An Assessed Application is released for offer decision.

### Consumes
Assessed Application supplies the applicant's qualifications and fee status. Quota Register supplies the remaining places per programme. Academic Policy supplies offer conditions. Offer Template supplies the standard wording.

### Steps
The applicant's qualifications are compared to programme entry requirements. If the applicant meets unconditional requirements and quota is available, an Unconditional Offer is issued. If conditional, a Conditional Offer is issued with conditions. The offer is recorded in the Quota Register as a provisional place. The applicant responds with an Offer Acceptance or rejection. Acceptances are matched against quota; if quota is full, accepted applicants are placed on a waiting list or offered an alternative. Once the applicant meets conditions, the Conditional Offer is converted to an Unconditional Offer. The final acceptance is confirmed.

### Produces
Conditional Offer. Unconditional Offer. Offer Acceptance. Updated Quota Register.

### Outcome
The institution has a controlled intake of accepted applicants within quota.

### Fails when
Quota is exhausted and no alternative is accepted, leaving applicants without a place.

Name: Organisational Design
Documentation:
### Identity
This process designs changes to the institution's organisational structure, roles, and responsibilities to align with strategic change. It is the part of the capability that ensures structural decisions are deliberate and consultative.

### Trigger
A Business Case requiring structural change, such as a new unit or merged department, is approved and starts the process when the current structure is known to be insufficient.

### Consumes
Current Organisation Structure supplies the existing reporting lines, roles, and headcount. Workforce Data supplies the staff capabilities, grades, and locations. Business Case supplies the strategic rationale and the required new capabilities.

### Steps
First the process analyses the Current Organisation Structure and Workforce Data against the Business Case. Then it develops two or more Organisation Design Options. It consults with affected staff and recognised trade unions, recording their feedback. It selects the preferred option based on feasibility, cost, and impact. It then prepares a Transition Plan setting out steps, dates, and responsibilities for implementation. If consultation identifies a legal risk, the process escalates to the governing body before proceeding.

### Produces
Organisation Design Options records the alternative structures considered and their assessment. Approved Organisation Structure records the new reporting lines and position titles. Transition Plan records the sequence of changes, affected posts, and consultation outcomes.

### Outcome
The institution has an approved organisational structure whose roles and reporting lines are aligned with the capabilities required by the approved Business Case.

### Fails when
Consultation feedback is not obtained or is disregarded, because the resulting structure faces legal challenge or staff resistance and the Transition Plan cannot be executed without industrial relations risk.

Name: Other Tertiary Institution Relationship Mgt
Documentation:
### Identity
Management of relationships with other tertiary institutions, including partnerships, benchmarking, and joint programmes.

### Trigger
The arrival of a collaboration proposal from another institution or a scheduled inter-institutional review.

### Consumes
Collaboration Proposal supplies the proposed activity and objectives. Institutional Profile supplies the other institution's strengths and reputation. Partnership Policy supplies the conditions for inter-institutional arrangements.

### Steps
